contract.operational_contract: Approved plan d2d2ea2e39102ab4193ee2f82b12b0823143867a23750c38d626aa4797eb7f5d and documentary protocol v1; no manuscript argument contract needed for this bounded screen.

findings.quoted_finding: The selected lagged-exposure applications do not yet establish the contemporaneous-effect estimand required by the plan.
defect_evidence: The documented models relate D[t−2] or D[t−1] to later Y[t].
The plan explicitly prohibits resolving absent CET applications by renaming time indices.
refuting_evidence: The implementation correctly calls its statistical object a future-outcome projection and recognizes causal limits; it does not claim completed causal identification.
mechanical_checks: Read cited primary text/code and frozen documentary criterion; no empirical estimation.
findings.reasoning: A future response can pass literal E2 without demonstrating the plan's contemporaneous target. A conditional contemporaneous/direct-effect label does not define a new intervention/window.
findings.disposition: Separate literal documentary classification from CET compatibility. State physical-time intervention, response window and treatment persistence. Update selection and any protocol version transparently; reserve changing the scientific target to the author.
findings.eligibility_impact: Prevents treating literal Blair eligibility or the proposed reserve as established CET applications.

findings.quoted_finding: The Ballard-Rosa inflation-crisis ficha asserts monthly crisis timing and pre-exposure Z[t−2] without sufficient documentary evidence.
source_locations: Ballard-Rosa article p. 49 note 94 and p. 50; pp. 39-46,49,57 substantive context
defect_evidence: The article describes controls as annual unless otherwise stated; exceptions named in the timing section are partisanship and Treasury.
The code uses both current and monthly-lag operators on crisis_inflation, which does not establish the measurement frequency of the source indicator.
refuting_evidence: Crisis has a substantive connection to partisan preferences and creditor risk; this is a different named control from GDP growth screened in Phase A.
The sources inspected do not affirmatively prove that no monthly exception exists elsewhere.
mechanical_checks: Read cited primary text/code and frozen documentary criterion; no empirical estimation.
findings.reasoning: The unresolved issue is the crisis measure's reference interval, not merely within-month ordering. An annual indicator repeated by month could invalidate Z[t−2] as strictly prior and carry later-month information in Z[t]. This is a source-based assessment of crisis, not a transfer of the GDP criticism.
findings.disposition: Mark E7 MISSING/HOLD; correct certainty that Z[t−2] is admissible. Identify primary crisis source, reference interval and timing rule; reconcile article/code. Preserve possible availability of older annual history.
findings.eligibility_impact: HOLD_DOCUMENTATION for the actual crisis contrast until timing is documented. E3 availability need not FAIL, but its specific proposed-lag justification is unsupported.

findings.quoted_finding: The absence of support→GDP in Claassen does not satisfy the frozen affirmative FAIL rule for E7.
source_locations: Claassen paper p. 17, equations 1-2; replication R:51-56
defect_evidence: Frozen E7 FAIL applies to invariant, only post-outcome, or unrelated controls; the primary DAG explicitly makes GDP a cause of both support and democracy.
refuting_evidence: The DAG does exclude support→GDP, so the implementation correctly refuses to invent mediation under the original assumptions.
mechanical_checks: Read cited primary text/code and frozen documentary criterion; no empirical estimation.
findings.reasoning: Missing evidence for a role-changing post-treatment contrast is not proof of the stated exclusion conditions. E7 PASS is also not yet demonstrated; HOLD preserves that distinction.
findings.disposition: Replace E7 FAIL and INELIGIBLE_DEMONSTRATED with MISSING/HOLD consistently. Revise reopening rule so it does not require proving a new D→Z arrow as the only admissible route; preserve separate CET limitation.
findings.eligibility_impact: Removes unsupported demonstrated ineligibility; does not make Claassen eligible or certify CET.

findings.quoted_finding: A later independent matching choice cannot eliminate uncertainty about influence from initially seen forbidden values.
defect_evidence: The documented sequence places roster access before protocol writing/freezing.
The claim that a matching independent route 'elimina a dúvida de influência' exceeds what agreement shows.
refuting_evidence: The incident is openly recorded; no evidence here demonstrates intentional use of numerical results.
Independent review can provide additional documentary support for a decision.
mechanical_checks: Read cited primary text/code and frozen documentary criterion; no empirical estimation.
findings.reasoning: Agreement cannot recover the initial analyst's counterfactual cognitive process or prove absence of influence on prioritization/protocol choices. The review also received an already fixed three-candidate set.
findings.disposition: Replace elimination claim with evidence-strengthening language and retain compromised initial blinding. State that freeze preceded classification but followed incidental exposure, per recorded sequence. Preserve incident and disagreements.
findings.eligibility_impact: Limits certification of blinding; does not independently demonstrate result-driven selection or disqualify a substantively justified candidate.

findings.quoted_finding: Phase A treated lack of explicit clustered VCE in Blair as sufficient for MISSING E5.
refuting_evidence: E5 requires identifiable panel and cluster/dependence level; it defers adequacy of eventual inference.
Country-year and within-country unit structure are documented; the implementation expressly flags conventional covariance and potential cross-country dependence.
mechanical_checks: Read cited primary text/code and frozen documentary criterion; no empirical estimation.
findings.reasoning: The initial reviewer objection demanded adequate original VCE rather than reconstructible structure. It was stronger than the frozen documentary requirement.
findings.disposition: Withdraw the Phase A E5 hold in the new round only, leaving Phase A bytes intact. Accept PASS documentary/risk; retain Gate 3 inference audit and do not equate FE with clustering.
findings.eligibility_impact: Blair changes to ELIGIBLE_DOCUMENTARY under literal E1–E7; independent CET obstacle remains.

findings.quoted_finding: The Ballard-Rosa ficha conflates exposure to a left government and transition into a left government.
defect_evidence: The proposed target uses 'passagem para/exposição a governo de esquerda'.
The original model uses lagged partisan category levels, including continuing governments and separate right/left contrasts against center/other.
refuting_evidence: Entry-into-office dates genuinely help construct the monthly partisan state; the source contains a meaningful exposure contrast.
mechanical_checks: Read cited primary text/code and frozen documentary criterion; no empirical estimation.
findings.reasoning: Monthly partisanship levels are not an adoption indicator. A dated observed government start is not automatically the intervention time for every observation or counterfactual comparison.
findings.disposition: Choose and state the partisan state and comparator, or explicitly propose a separate transition design. Do not silently collapse the original multi-category contrast.
findings.eligibility_impact: E1 can remain PASS for the original categorical exposure; proposed intervention must be made unambiguous.
